title: 第9章 真身入神只第10章 真实与虚幻
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
“行了行了！”
赵雷适时打断，“你俩就别在门口上演兄弟情深了！
进店再聊！”
“赵叔说的是！”
沈算与烈焰相视一笑，并肩随着人流涌入店内。
应酬宾客，笑脸相迎，尤其是有意结交、察言观色、投其所好的应酬，是极其耗费心神的。
送走最后一位宾客，返回后院的沈算几乎累瘫在凉亭石凳上，嗓子干得都快冒烟了，脸颊更是因长时间保持笑容而隐隐发僵。
“少爷，快喝口茶润润嗓子！”
陈静早已泡好温热的香茗，一脸关切地奉上。
“嗯…”
沈算有气无力地应了一声，捧起茶杯，小口吹着气。
“少爷您先歇着，奴婢这就去把温着的饭菜端来！”
陈静说完，不等沈算回应，便像只轻盈的小鹿般朝院外跑去。
开业大吉，生意兴隆与否，一算账便知。
灯火通明的凉亭中，众人屏息凝神，围在钟宇身旁，看着他执笔在账本上飞快地写写画画。
拥有“铜钱”
神演物的人，对数字与金钱的敏锐毋庸置疑。
很快，在众人期待的目光中，钟宇搁下笔，抬起头，脸上带着一丝不易察觉的振奋：“得益于烈焰狩猎团的大宗采购，今日总交易额：黄金五百两，下品玄石一百枚！”
“哇！”
陈静忍不住小声惊呼，眨着灵动的眼睛追问：“钟叔，那…那咱们赚了多少呀？”

“因是开张酬宾，让利颇多，加之烈焰团长的‘贺礼’也折价计入成本，”
钟宇沉稳地解释：“单论今日，净利确实不算丰厚，但关键不在于此。
“今日最大的收获，是打开了渠道，建立了口碑。”
“今后的细水长流，才是真正的财富之源！”
“哦……”
陈静似懂非懂地点点头。
“好了，账也算完了。”
沈算揉了揉眉心，挥手道：“都回去歇息吧，明日还有得忙。”
“是，少爷！”
钟财等人恭敬告退，唯有钟宇留了下来。
钟宇端起茶杯抿了一口，看向疲惫却眼神清明的沈算：“少爷是在思虑，今日陈夫人、烈焰团长等人为何如此厚待，甚至显得…过于熟稔？”
content_en:
"Okay, okay!"
Zhao Lei interrupted at the right time, "You two, stop acting like brothers at the door!
Let’s talk later in the store! "
"Uncle Zhao said that!"
Shen Suan and Lie Yan smiled at each other and followed the crowd into the store side by side.
Entertaining guests and greeting them with a smile, especially those who intend to make friends, observe their words, and cater to their liking, are extremely energy-consuming.
After seeing off the last guest and returning to the backyard, Shen Suan almost collapsed on the stone bench in the pavilion from exhaustion. His throat was so dry that it was almost smoking, and his cheeks were slightly stiff from maintaining a smile for a long time.
"Master, drink some tea quickly to moisten your throat!"
Chen Jing had already made warm tea and served it with concern on her face.
"Well..."
Shen Suan responded feebly, picked up the tea cup and blew in a small mouth.
"Master, please rest first. I will bring you warm food right now!"
After Chen Jing finished speaking, without waiting for Shen Suan's response, she ran out of the courtyard like a light deer.
If your business is successful and your business is booming, you will know as soon as you settle the accounts.
In the brightly lit pavilion, everyone gathered around Zhong Yu with bated breath, watching him write and draw quickly on the account book.
Possess "copper coins"
People who are good at acting are undoubtedly keen on numbers and money.
Soon, under the expectant gaze of everyone, Zhong Yu put down his pen and raised his head, with a hint of unnoticeable excitement on his face: "Thanks to the bulk purchase of the Lieyan Hunting Group, today's total transaction volume: five hundred taels of gold and one hundred low-grade black stones!"
"Wow!"
Chen Jing couldn't help but exclaim in a low voice, blinking her smart eyes and asking: "Uncle Zhong, then...how much did we earn?"
"Because it is an opening reward, the profits are quite large, and the 'congratulatory gift' from Captain Lieyan is also discounted and included in the cost,"
Zhong Yu explained calmly: "Taking today alone, the net profit is indeed not huge, but that's not the key.
“The biggest gain today is opening up channels and building a reputation. "
“The steady flow from now on is the real source of wealth! "
"Oh..."
Chen Jing nodded as if understanding.
"Okay, the accounts are settled. "
Shen Suan rubbed his brows, waved his hand and said, "Go back and rest, we will be busy tomorrow. "
"Yes, Master! "
Zhong Cai and others respectfully resigned, but Zhong Yu stayed.
Zhong Yu picked up the tea cup and took a sip, looking at Shen Suan who was tired but with clear eyes: "Young Master is thinking about why Mrs. Chen, Captain Lieyan and others are so generous today, and even seem... too familiar? "
